rationale: After 49 minutes in the trade and an initial move in our favor, price has reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($184.54) on surging 1-minute buying volume (11,079 and 25,059 shares on the last two bars). Simultaneously, the broad market is bouncing off its lows (SPY improving from -4.00% to -3.60% and VIXY pulling back from +25.27% to +21.70%), eroding the immediate downside continuation thesis and warranting an exit near breakeven.
